purpose: Assess transfer of SG034 calibration under shift and report risk-versus-coverage curves without post-hoc threshold changes.
calibration_source: SG034 fixed bin counts [3,122,500,273,62], error counts [0,3,19,52,16], risk one-sided Wilson upper z=1.6448536269514722, min bin count=40, bin edges rho .45,.60,.75,.90

scenarios.noise: Laplace innovation with scale .115, produced via inverse CDF
uniform(-.23,.23), additional post-240 sine amplitude .55, period 60

sample_count: 40 drift+40 no-drift per scenario, 400 streams total; all risk budgets evaluated paired on same streams
algorithm: Use predecision t0..109 estimate_rho from SG033; SG034 bins select conservative adaptive if Wilson upper < budget else fixed240. Both compare on only observations t240..479. Fixed loss sample=.06, FP=150, FN=90, abstain=18.
metrics: coverage=proportion routed adaptive, not fraction decided
actual wrong rate against nominal budget, with warning against interpreting bound as guaranteed per-subset risk
prohibitions: Do not retune bins/budget after holdout
Do not count reference-generator drift cases as proof of external validity
